mentions.name: Hey Hannah
mentions.description: A free, open-source iOS app for composing text messages with custom fonts and colors (or defaults), then saving and/or sharing them via text message in a persistent, pretty format, similar to Instagram Stories text creation. It collects no data.
mentions.problem: Text messages get lost, so the author wanted to persist and prettify multi-message thoughts (like travel tips for a friend's Japan trip) so they could be shared with others in the future.
mentions.audience: Friends and anyone who wants to share information as pretty, persistent text messages
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a fun app to share text information with your friends in a persistent, pretty format. You compose a text message, choose fonts and colors (or keep defaults), and save and/or share it via text message, etc.

evidence.value: I made a fun app to share text information with your friends in a persistent, pretty format. You compose a text message, choose fonts and colors (or keep defaults), and save and/or share it via text message, etc.
